name: maestro
description: Deterministic local execution service for shell commands, LLM inference, embeddings, reranking, text chunking, vector operations, planner-managed memory, file I/O, artifacts, audit events, managed async tasks, Docker operations, service introspection, and multi-step pipelines.

naming.manifest_to_adapter: Prefix with maestro_ and replace dots with underscores, e.g. memory.put -> maestro_memory_put.

auth.note: Read-only service endpoints except /health require API-key auth by default unless the server explicitly exposes them publicly.
